articles.headline: Denmark: Russian intelligence plotted to kill a Ukrainian-American on Danish soil; Copenhagen expels Russia's defence attaché
articles.summary:
**Danish prosecutors told a court in Lyngby on Friday that two Danish men, linked to the banned Loyal to Familia gang, were hired by Russian intelligence to kill the Ukrainian-American rapper Kyivstoner (Albert Vasiliev) at a concert in Charlottenlund on 25 September; police stopped their car in Hellerup about five minutes before the show and found two loaded pistols and two knives (DR, TV 2, Hromadske).**

The Security and Intelligence Service (PET) says the plot was "planned and initiated" by Russian intelligence. Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen announced that Russia's defence attaché must leave Denmark within seven days (Euronews). TV 2 called it the first time Danish police have so clearly charged that a Russian intelligence service planned a killing in Denmark.

**Context:** It is the second attempt on the same man: Poland foiled the first in August 2026 and arrested a Russian national (Polish MFA, DR). Russia's FSB has accused Vasiliev of organising a drone supply chain for attacks on the Moscow region, an allegation that has not been independently established, and Russian state TV said killing him would be "a matter of honour" for the service (DR). Both suspects deny the charges. The Polish MFA said Warsaw supports the measures Denmark proposed "to limit the access and freedom of travel of Russian nationals on the EU territory" and called for a "robust and coordinated" EU and NATO reaction to "any further Russian provocation or act of state terrorism". Germany's Foreign Office called the plot "appalling" and said Denmark "can count on our unwavering solidarity".

**Sources:** [Polish MFA](https://x.com/i/status/2123836740339171436), [German Foreign Office](https://x.com/i/status/2123836093703528741), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/two-danes-suspected-of-russian-backed-plot-to-kill-ukrainian-rapper), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/denmark-russia-ukraine-intelligence-tensions-poland-plot-03494b78067c9572120deac038addd23), [DR](https://www.dr.dk/nyheder/udland/det-ved-vi-om-rapperen-som-rusland-angiveligt-ville-have-draebt-i-danmark), [TV 2](https://nyheder.tv2.dk/krimi/2026-11-20-rusland-hyrede-to-maend-bosat-i-danmark-til-at-draebe-ukrainsk-rapper-lyder-sigtelse), [Hromadske](https://hromadske.ua/en/europa/274710-two-danish-men-accused-of-plotting-to-kill-ukrainian-rapper-kyivstoner-for-russian-intelligence)
articles.why: On the same day as the missile in Poland, an EU capital reports a state-organised murder plot outsourced to local criminals. Each country expels diplomats and closes its own borders alone; a common EU answer (Schengen-wide limits on Russian nationals' travel, joint counter-intelligence) only works if the 27 act together, which is what Denmark and Poland are now asking for.
articles.watch: Russia's response (tit-for-tat expulsion); whether the Danish proposal on Russian nationals' travel reaches the Council agenda; any link between the Polish and Danish plots (not established so far).

articles.headline: "NATO for Donbas": US envoys float membership for Ukraine in exchange for territory; Washington wants a deal by early January
articles.summary:
**The Wall Street Journal reports that Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have raised two end-of-war scenarios with Ukrainian and European officials: Ukraine withdraws from the part of Donbas it still holds in exchange for full NATO membership, or the front is frozen, Ukraine stays outside NATO and receives treaty-based security guarantees from the US and possibly European allies (WSJ via Kyiv Post, Anadolu, DW).**

Kushner raised the idea in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 November, with a Russian delegation present, and with Zelensky and European national security advisers at a Dublin military airfield on 12 November. A US official said many ideas are under discussion and both Moscow and Kyiv must agree. Separately, the Financial Times reports that the administration wants a Ukraine–Russia peace deal by early January 2027 (via @clashreport).

**Context:** Zelensky confirmed the question: "What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?", and repeated that Ukraine "is not giving up its land". According to a Russian position paper seen by the WSJ, Moscow wants NATO aspirations removed from Ukraine's constitution, no allied troops or equipment in Ukraine, an end to Western arms deliveries and NATO infrastructure in Eastern Europe rolled back to 1997 levels; European negotiators call these maximalist opening positions (DW, Anadolu). Macron said after Berlin on 18 November that it was time to discuss Ukraine's NATO membership, while Merz reportedly told aides he does not expect it in his lifetime (DW, citing WSJ). Kushner said in Berlin on Thursday that Trump is open to an Article 5-like guarantee (Türkiye Today).

**Sources:** [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90709), [Kyiv Post](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/us-floats-possible-nato-membership-for-ukraine-in-exchange-for-territorial-concessions-report/4131927), [DW](https://www.dw.com/ru/wsj-ssa-obsuzdaut-vstuplenie-ukrainy-v-nato-v-obmen-na-donbass/a-79999651), [Türkiye Today](https://www.turkiyetoday.com/world/nato-for-donbas-us-envoys-float-ukraine-membership-if-kyiv-cedes-territory-report-3232821), [@clashreport](https://x.com/i/status/2123781999118721299), [and](https://x.com/i/status/2123815709771714741), [Anadolu on X](https://x.com/i/status/2123763301050093766)
articles.why: Washington is putting NATO membership, which requires the unanimous consent of all 32 allies under Article 10, on the table as a bargaining chip, while Europeans, who would carry most of any guarantee, are told about it in side meetings. Europe is divided (Paris open, Berlin sceptical) on the very offer the US is making in its name. A Europe with its own defence would negotiate as a principal, not as the guarantor of last resort.
articles.watch: Allied reactions in the NATO Council; Kremlin answer (Russia has rejected Ukraine's NATO membership throughout); whether the January target is confirmed by the White House.

articles.headline: Update: Trump calls Russian missiles in Poland "little" and "by mistake"; Europe's leaders answer that Russia is choosing confrontation
articles.summary:
**New since 14:30: in a Fox News phone interview aboard Air Force One on Thursday, hours before Friday's Kh-101 impact, Trump said: "Putin has been landing drones in Poland and a couple of little missiles, by mistake", while answering Tusk's "God, protect us from such friends" with "I like the Polish prime minister.**

Don't forget I endorsed him" (Fox News, Kyiv Post, Hromadske). Speaking in Washington on Friday about his Asia trip, Trump said "President Putin of Russia clearly expressed his desire to see the war between Russia and Ukraine end by diplomatic means" and "I get along with Russia. I get along with China" (clips by @atrupar, @clashreport, @Acyn). Putin, in Tajikistan, said he has "no doubt" Trump "is genuinely committed to resolving conflicts, including the conflict in Ukraine" (Russian Embassy in the US, reposted by the Russian MFA).

**Context:** The 14:30 edition covered the missile near Nowy Lipowiec and Tusk's "intentional provocation". This afternoon European Council President António Costa said "Russia continues to threaten EU Member States. Russia is going in the wrong direction"; Kaja Kallas: "If Moscow wants peace, its actions tell a different story"; Germany's Foreign Office spoke of "yet another example of Russia's ongoing provocations"; Poland's MFA spokesman said "Poland will neither be intimidated nor provoked… We will act on our own terms". Sweden said its JAS Gripens flew overnight with Polish F-16s and an allied tanker. In Nowa Dęba, Polish Defence Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz thanked the defence ministers of France, the UK, Lithuania and Estonia for attending the Coalition of the Willing exercise; UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting: "We will not allow Putin to divide our continent."

**Sources:** [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/trump-to-meet-xi-in-shenzhen-ahead-of-high-stakes-trilateral-talks-with-putin), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90744), [Hromadske](https://hromadske.ua/en/world/274725-trump-calls-russian-missiles-entering-poland-little-says-they-landed-by-mistake), [@atrupar](https://x.com/i/status/2123837168363745527), [@Acyn](https://x.com/i/status/2123837396420817269), [@Acyn](https://x.com/i/status/2123837327080632679), [Costa](https://x.com/i/status/2123825904941990006), [Kallas via EEAS](https://x.com/i/status/2123820392145998144), [German Foreign Office](https://x.com/i/status/2123770450845069326), [Polish MFA](https://x.com/i/status/2123790881568293253), [Swedish Armed Forces](https://x.com/i/status/2123767246690660408), [Kosiniak-Kamysz via Streeting](https://x.com/i/status/2123824222455644473), [Streeting](https://x.com/i/status/2123818645512126817)
articles.why: The ally whose guarantee underpins NATO describes as accidental the strikes that frontline governments call deliberate. Europe's reaction came from a coalition of individual states (Poland, UK, France, Sweden, Baltics) plus EU statements; the shield over the eastern flank still depends on how Washington reads Russian intent.
articles.watch: Whether Poland requests Article 4 consultations; any White House clarification; Kremlin comment on the Polish impacts.

articles.headline: EU money for Ukraine: €1 billion for joint procurement from the Peace Facility and a record €7.9 billion budget payment
articles.summary:
**The Council adopted two decisions mobilising €1 billion under the European Peace Facility (EPF) for the joint procurement of drones, air-defence equipment, ammunition, electronic-warfare equipment, radar systems and explosives for Ukraine's armed forces, to be delivered by the end of 2027 (Council press release).**

It is the last part of the €6.6 billion EPF package agreed on 25 September 2026, which ended Hungary's block on the facility (Kyiv Independent, Kyiv Post). The same day the Commission released €7.9 billion under the Ukraine Facility, "our largest single payment", to keep Ukraine's public administration running (European Commission; von der Leyen: "nearly €8 billion", reposted by @F_CEAFE).

**Context:** According to the Council, EPF support to Ukraine reaches €11.8 billion since 2021, including €9.9 billion to reimburse member states' bilateral aid and €950 million for EUMAM training; €3.5 billion of windfall profits from immobilised Russian assets have also been channelled through the EPF, of which more than €1.5 billion bought equipment directly from Ukraine's defence industry. Kallas: "There are zero signs Russia wants peace… Ukraine can count on Europe to strengthen its hand on the battlefield and at the negotiating table" (Ukrainska Pravda).

**Sources:** [Council](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/20/european-peace-facility-council-mobilises-additional-1-billion-in-new-military-aid-to-ukraine/), [@EUCouncilPress](https://x.com/i/status/2123792676487037116), [Kallas via EEAS](https://x.com/i/status/2123820392145998144), [Ukraine MoD](https://x.com/i/status/2123807521743819135), [European Commission](https://x.com/i/status/2123819288817451345), [European Commission](https://x.com/i/status/2123756500565020815), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/eu-greenlights-1-billion-euros-in-military-support-for-ukraine-as-top-diplomat-says-russia-rejects-peace/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90751), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063845/)
articles.why: Joint procurement through a common EU instrument, rather than 27 separate national purchases, is the model CEAFE argues for. The press release does not say where the equipment will be bought; whether this €1 billion goes to European and Ukrainian industry, or to US systems as with PURL, is the test.
articles.watch: Tender rules and any European-preference clause; next Ukraine Facility tranches.

articles.headline: Bosnia and Herzegovina: Constitutional Court strikes down a Serb veto; Dodik announces a blockade of state institutions
articles.summary:
**At its 176th plenary session (19–20 November) the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina annulled the vital-national-interest veto of Serb Presidency member Željka Cvijanović against the appointment of members of the Commission to Preserve National Monuments, and the Republika Srpska National Assembly decision confirming it (7 July, 59 votes to 2).**

It also found unconstitutional the Republika Srpska criminal-code article that criminalises displaying symbols of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (Constitutional Court; Nezavisne novine; Avaz). SNSD leader Milorad Dodik said "this is the demolition of Dayton… we will not get past this", and that no SNSD minister will take any decision in the state Council of Ministers until the ruling is withdrawn; on X he wrote that Bosnia "died today… euthanasia was carried out by the Constitutional Court".

**Context:** Cvijanović called the ruling "a coup against the constitutional order". Dodik will ask for a Republika Srpska National Assembly session to reject the decisions, and called them "a typical Muslim conspiracy to destroy Republika Srpska" (SRNA, Republika Srpska agency). Greece hosts the "Friends of the Western Balkans" foreign ministers in Athens on 23 November (Greek MFA).

Background (CEAFE archive): @F_CEAFE has followed Dodik's challenge to the Bosnian state since March 2023, when he threatened secession and CEAFE noted that territorial integrity is treated in opposite ways depending on the country; in August 2025 the Central Election Commission terminated Dodik's mandate as Republika Srpska president.

**Sources:** [Constitutional Court](https://www.ustavnisud.ba/en/176th-plenary-session), [Nezavisne novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Ustavni-sud-BiH-srusio-veto-Narodne-skupstine-Dodik-najavio-odgovor/993449), [Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089580/dodik-bijesan-zbog-odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-blokirat-cemo-vijece-ministara), [SRNA](https://www.srna.rs/en/novost/1450105/dodik:-incomplete-bih-constitutional-court-rulings-will-not-stand), [Dodik on X](https://x.com/i/status/2123817393377997293), [Greek MFA](https://x.com/i/status/2123812224993239358), [@F_CEAFE](https://x.com/i/status/1634875717010980864), [@F_CEAFE](https://x.com/i/status/1953401283529900347)
articles.why: Bosnia is an EU candidate where the EU runs the EUFOR Althea mission; a boycott of the Council of Ministers by the main Serb party blocks the reforms the accession path requires and tests whether the EU can keep stability in its own neighbourhood without relying on Washington, as it did at Dayton.
articles.watch: RS Assembly session; reaction of the EU delegation, the High Representative and EUFOR; Athens meeting on 23 November.

articles.headline: US and Chinese militaries hold maritime safety talks in Shanghai while Beijing presses Tokyo and Washington on Taiwan
articles.summary:
**From 18 to 20 November the Chinese and US militaries held the 2nd working-group meeting and the 2026 annual session of the Military Maritime Consultative Agreement (MMCA) in Shanghai, reviewing the memorandum on rules of behaviour for air and maritime encounters and discussing measures to improve maritime military security, in "candid, pragmatic and constructive" talks (China Military, PLA outlet; Global Times, reposted by @F_CEAFE).**

At the same time China's MFA told Japan that "the pressing priority is to correct the erroneous words and moves on the Taiwan question", and Global Times said PM Takaichi's statement that Japan's stance is "unchanged" did little to ease concerns. The South China Morning Post (owned by Alibaba) reports that Xi pressed Trump to do "the right thing" on Taiwan and asks where that leaves US arms sales.

**Context:** Taiwan has flagged nearly 2,700 suspected China-linked accounts to Meta ahead of its 28 November local elections (via @clashreport). @F_CEAFE also reposted Global Times criticising US politicians who want Washington to stop certifying Chinese-made aircraft and to withdraw contracts from foreign defence firms that invest in China's aerospace sector, which Beijing calls "politicizing normal business".

**Sources:** [China Military](https://x.com/i/status/2123750248824893609), [China Military](https://x.com/i/status/2123760276181037510), [and](https://x.com/i/status/2123760310716973464), [China MFA](https://x.com/i/status/2123764509621780490), [Global Times](https://x.com/i/status/2123810058530324821), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3375260/xi-presses-trump-do-right-thing-taiwan-where-does-leave-us-arms-sales), [@clashreport](https://x.com/i/status/2123757161326968851)
articles.why: Washington and Beijing build crisis-management channels between themselves; Europe, whose trade depends on the Taiwan Strait and the South China Sea, has no equivalent seat. The threat to strip US contracts from foreign defence firms that invest in China would hit European companies through US extraterritorial rules.
articles.watch: Any US arms-sale notification to Taiwan; Japan–China contacts; Taiwan's election.

articles.headline: EU–UK summit seals the first post-Brexit reset deals: youth mobility, food trade and linked carbon markets
articles.summary:
**The second EU–UK summit in Brussels ended with Prime Minister Andy Burnham's office announcing "The deal is done – negotiations have concluded" on three agreements: a Youth Experience Scheme, an agri-food (SPS) agreement and the linking of the EU and UK emissions trading systems (The Guardian; Euronews).**

The youth scheme will let 100,000 young people from each side live, work or study in the other for up to three years, running by January 2030 at the latest; the SPS agreement targets 1 March 2028, and the UK rejoins Erasmus+ from 1 January 2027 (The Guardian; Euronews; Al Jazeera). A Council of the EU statement says adoption of the three agreements "shall not precede the conclusion of the negotiations" on equal treatment of EU students on tuition fees, due within six months (Politico Europe; Rapporteur). EU student enrolment at UK universities fell 57% between 2020/21 and 2023/24 (Migration Observatory, via Euronews). Burnham: "This is a good day for Britain, this is a good day for Europe… There is some hope on the horizon" for young people in Britain.

On the same day, Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced that the EU is disbursing nearly €8 billion to Ukraine, "the largest payment made so far": €7.9 billion under the Ukraine Facility. Her video puts overall EU support for Ukraine at €245.5 billion since 2022, that is, since the start of the Ukraine war (@vonderleyen).

**Context:** The summit, hosted by António Costa and von der Leyen, had been planned for July but was postponed when Keir Starmer resigned; the three deals were initiated under Starmer (The Guardian; 08:30 edition preview). The draft joint statement says both sides are "implementing the EU-UK Security and Defence Partnership" (Agence Europe).

**Sources:** [The Guardian live](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/20/uk-eu-european-union-brexit-deal-andy-burnham-latest-news-updates), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/young-europeans-win-a-route-back-to-the-uk-but-not-cheaper-university-fees-yet), [Politico Europe](https://www.politico.eu/article/brussels-to-link-uk-eu-summit-package-to-tuition-fee-demands/), [Rapporteur](https://www.rapporteur.com/news/tuition-fees-talks-delay-adoption-of-eu-uk-deal/), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/eu-and-uk-seal-reset-deal), [@vonderleyen](https://x.com/i/status/2123734797474218034), [@AJEnglish](https://x.com/i/status/2123740316520132788), [@FT](https://x.com/i/status/2123731768465334414), [Burnham clip](https://x.com/i/status/2123744465181454448), [@EU_Eurostat](https://x.com/i/status/2123717996833132609), [Letta](https://x.com/i/status/2123695566299537889), [Breton](https://x.com/i/status/2123729601113592193)
articles.why: The Union negotiated as one and kept its leverage by tying the package to tuition fees: that is how a bloc of 27 obtains terms from a large neighbour that none of its members would get alone. SPS and emissions trading are single-market areas, so this is the first step back towards single-market rules since Brexit. Enrico Letta (reposted by @F_CEAFE) presented the Trump–Xi–Putin picture as the strongest argument for completing the single market, and Thierry Breton asked: "France alone, Germany alone, are they big enough…?". The €245.5 billion for Ukraine is a scale of support only the Union as a whole can sustain.
articles.watch: The final joint statement; the tuition-fee talks within six months; defence and security cooperation and possible UK access to SAFE.

articles.headline: Helsing's "Clarity" vs Palantir's Maven: a European bid for the software that runs NATO targeting
articles.summary:
**On 20 November @F_CEAFE reposted Helsing's message "We need to control our destiny.**

That's why we launched Clarity, our sovereign European agentic intelligence platform" (Helsing on X). Clarity, unveiled on 11 November, uses "hundreds of agents" to fuse satellite imagery, drone video, signals, open sources and field reports, mark adversary assets and prepare engagement data for "the effector best suited", with "a human" validating every threat and hand-off (Helsing). It is "built in Europe, under European control", runs on infrastructure each force owns, follows NATO standards and connects to effectors "from any manufacturer". Helsing co-CEO Gundbert Scherf: "A capability this critical must be sovereign" (Kyiv Independent).

**Context:** NATO already uses Palantir's Maven Smart System, and Ukraine has used Palantir technology for intelligence analysis and long-range strike planning (Kyiv Independent). Reporting so far names no customer and no service-entry date for Clarity (The Next Web; Startuprad). The repost came on the same day the US ambassador to the EU warned Brussels against a proposed act (#CADA) that would limit "top U.S. tech companies" in Europe's AI economy: "The U.S. is not the enemy."

**Sources:** [@HelsingAI](https://x.com/i/status/2123703016771695050), [@HelsingAI](https://x.com/i/status/2123724233243271585), [Helsing](https://helsing.ai/clarity/), [and](https://helsing.ai/newsroom/helsing-unveils-clarity-a-sovereign-software-platform-for-military-intelligence), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/helsing-launches-european-alternative-to-palantirs-military-ai/), [The Next Web](https://thenextweb.com/news/helsing-clarity-palantir-maven-rival-karp-democrat), [@USAmbEU](https://x.com/i/status/2123686222648226269)
articles.why: The software that turns sensor data into targets is the core of modern command and control. If NATO's targeting runs on a US platform, European forces depend on US code, updates, data handling and export permission: a potential kill switch on the most sensitive layer of defence. A European alternative exists; whether it gains scale depends on European governments buying it together (EDF/EDIP/SAFE, joint procurement), not on the product alone.
articles.watch: First national or NATO-agency customer; whether EU funding instruments or the "European preference" rules favour sovereign C2 software; US pushback (CADA, Colby's line on buying American).

articles.headline: A Russian Kh-101 lands in Poland during one of the largest strikes of the war; Tusk speaks of an "intentional provocation"
articles.summary:
**Poland's Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz confirmed that a Russian Kh-101 cruise missile violated Polish airspace and fell near Nowy Lipowiec (Biłgoraj county, Lublin province, about 50 km from the Ukrainian border) shortly after 06:30 local time; a second object at Rudnik nad Sanem was probably also a missile and a third, at Mołodycz, most likely a jet-powered drone (Onet, BBC Polska, Kyiv Independent).**

The Operational Command said 11 objects threatened Polish airspace and three entered it; Polish and allied F-16 and Gripen pairs flew all night, and air traffic controllers at Rzeszów airport were evacuated. No one was hurt and no critical infrastructure was damaged. Prime Minister Donald Tusk convened ministers, the military and the heads of the services and said: "We know that what landed on Polish soil came from Russia… it does not look like an accident. It appears that we are dealing with an intentional provocation", adding that this was also the assessment of "foreign partners, including those within NATO" (France 24).

**Context:** Kosiniak-Kamysz linked the timing to the Coalition of the Willing exercise under way in Poland with British and French troops, and called the overnight attack "one of the largest since the beginning of the full-scale war". UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting, who had just arrived in Poland, called it "very serious" and said "the UK stands in solidarity with our allies". **Russia's side:** the Kremlin had not commented by early afternoon, and Russian outlets (Vedomosti, Interfax) reported the alert without naming the objects' origin (Rzeczpospolita). The same morning the Russian MFA spokeswoman Maria Zakharova (official Russian source) said NATO "is openly preparing for an armed conflict with Russia" within "3-5 years" and that "Russia has no intention of attacking NATO states". In September 2025, after a similar incident, Russia's Defence Ministry said it had "not planned" strikes on Polish targets.

**Sources:** [Onet](https://wiadomosci.onet.pl/kraj/wladyslaw-kosiniak-kamysz-potwierdza-spadla-rakieta-ch-101/ne8lxs6), [BBC Polska](https://www.bbc.com/polska/articles/c9gklm84kzemo), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261120-poland-says-russian-missile-hit-its-territory-during-attack-on-ukraine), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/poland-reports-airspace-violation-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine-investigates-debris-crash/), [Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/rosyjskie-drony-nad-polska/art45520101-rosyjskie-media-o-incydencie-w-polsce-rbk-cytuje-lawrowa-meduza-wskazuje-na-ataki-kremla), [@donaldtusk](https://x.com/i/status/2123698389552701453), [@donaldtusk](https://x.com/i/status/2123724974665912602), [@donaldtusk](https://x.com/i/status/2123692969022914763), [@wesstreeting](https://x.com/i/status/2123730277688025120), [@mfa_russia](https://x.com/i/status/2123710576849211756), [@clashreport](https://x.com/i/status/2123720157138698600)
articles.why: A cruise missile falling 50 km inside an EU and NATO state is the most direct spill-over of the Ukraine war into Union territory in this window. Each frontline state answers alone (national crisis cell, national jets, bilateral visits), while air defence of the eastern flank depends on allied rotations. A common European air- and missile-defence shield, built and paid for together, is the capability no single member state can afford by itself.
articles.watch: Whether Warsaw requests NATO Article 4 consultations (not announced so far); final identification of the second and third objects; any Kremlin or Russian MoD statement.

articles.headline: Update: Moscow weighs a visit by three EU envoys but rules out any NATO formula; Europeans reject a "Yalta-style" deal
articles.summary:
**Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergey Ryabkov said a visit by three EU representatives to Russia is "under consideration", but that "even the notion of a formula for Ukraine's quasi-membership of NATO… is unacceptable to us" (Interfax via Al Jazeera).**

European leaders "forcefully rejected a 'Yalta-style' deal" after the Shenzhen meeting (Euronews), and Chancellor Merz said: "Russia will not win this war" (@clashreport clip). Anadolu, citing a report on Trump's call into the Berlin meeting, says he questioned continued European military aid to Ukraine. Former Commissioner Thierry Breton, reposted by @F_CEAFE: "La France seule, l'Allemagne seule ont-elles la taille pour répondre ? Évidemment non… c'est la France qu'on affaiblit quand on affaiblit l'Europe."

**Context:** Yesterday Kushner said Russia accepts Europeans in a multilateral format and an "Article 5"-based guarantee (08:30 edition, story 1). Ryabkov's words contradict that reading on NATO. Who the "three EU representatives" would be has not been stated.

**Sources:** [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/russia-unleashes-retaliatory-barrage-on-kyiv-bridges), [@euronews](https://x.com/i/status/2123694927033123297), [@euronews](https://x.com/i/status/2123736715038699781), [@anadoluagency](https://x.com/i/status/2123699160230547636), [@ThierryBreton](https://x.com/i/status/2123708988252446814), [@ThierryBreton](https://x.com/i/status/2123729601113592193)
articles.why: For the first time Moscow speaks of EU (not national) envoys, yet the Union still has no agreed negotiator. Breton's point is CEAFE's: no member state alone has the size to sit at the Shenzhen table.
articles.watch: Names and mandate of any EU delegation; the first multilateral round Zelensky wants "as soon as possible".

articles.headline: Hungary lifts its veto: Ukraine and Moldova can open the last EU accession clusters
articles.summary:
**EU ambassadors (Coreper) approved on 20 November, without debate, the screening results for clusters 4 (Green agenda and sustainable connectivity) and 5 (Resources, agriculture and cohesion) for both Ukraine and Moldova, after Hungary signalled it would no longer block them (Ukrainska Pravda; Euronews).**

Budapest had refused at working-party level on 20 and 27 October and on 3 and 10 November. Formal opening still needs unanimous EU common positions and intergovernmental conferences; the next General Affairs Council is on 15 December.

**Context:** The shift follows Péter Magyar's victory over Viktor Orbán and an October Kyiv–Budapest deal on the Hungarian minority. Orbán reposted a post claiming Magyar "is about to drop Hungary's veto". The Commission has proposed carve-outs for some Ukrainian farm products under pressure from Poland and France (Euronews).

**Sources:** [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063776/), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/hungary-to-drop-veto-on-ukraines-remaining-eu-accession-clusters), [@PM_ViktorOrban](https://x.com/i/status/2123719070520320469)
articles.why: Unanimity let one capital freeze enlargement for years; this unblocks it, but member states can still veto "more than 100 times" along the way. Enlargement to Ukraine changes the Union's budget, farm policy and defence-industrial base.

articles.headline: Xi hails the "historic" trilateral; CEAFE: "not supporting Taiwan's independence is only one part of the American position"
articles.summary:
**@ChinaMilBugle quoted Xi Jinping calling the Shenzhen trilateral "key to world peace" and saying the "post-WWII order should be cherished", recalling China, Russia and the US as "key anti-fascist forces".**

Quoting it, @F_CEAFE wrote that not supporting Taiwan's independence "is only one part of the American position—a stance also adopted by all of its allies"; through the G7, NATO and the Quad the US stresses "peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait", opposes unilateral changes to the status quo and supports Taiwan's participation in international organisations — as in the G7 declaration of 11 November in Paris, "with the EU also participating" — and "we must not overlook U.S. arms sales to Taiwan, the transit of U.S. military vessels and aircraft through the Strait… or even the presence of U.S. military personnel on the island". China's MFA, asked whether Beijing proposed regular three-way exchanges, answered via Global Times (Chinese state media).

**Sources:** [@F_CEAFE](https://x.com/i/status/2123673664423899489), [@ChinaMilBugle](https://x.com/ChinaMilBugle/status/2123579358174732334), [@globaltimesnews](https://x.com/i/status/2123684958137209321), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy)
articles.why: The EU signs G7 language on Taiwan drafted around US strategy while being absent from the table where the US, China and Russia discuss world order. Xi meanwhile held talks with Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Australia on trade and AI (SCMP, Alibaba-owned).

articles.headline: Update: Trump phones Berlin — "Friedrich, you can make a call to Putin"; Kushner says Russia accepts Europeans at the table
articles.summary:
**On his flight back from China, Donald Trump called into the Berlin Coalition of the Willing meeting and told European leaders and Zelensky: "Putin wants to end the war, he wants the deal done, he is getting tired of this", urging them to engage Putin directly: "Friedrich, you can make a call to Putin and this will make a deal" (Axios, citing people in the room).**

At the closing press conference, US envoy Jared Kushner said "Russia has agreed to engage in the multilateral format with the Europeans" and that Moscow is "comfortable" with security guarantees "based on Article 5"; giving such a guarantee "is a really, really big deal… something that President Trump is open to, but obviously it has to be in America's interest" (The Guardian live; AP; Channel 8). Kushner: "President Trump wants to make a deal with Europe by his side. He's not looking to impose anything unilaterally" (Axios). Friedrich Merz said the best prospects for peace lie in talks where "Ukraine, Russia, the United States and Europe" are represented, set the order "first peace in Ukraine, then understandings on Euro-Atlantic security", and noted UK pledges of over €11 billion alongside the Commission's proposed €45 billion for 2027 (Bundesregierung). Merz on X: "President Putin, end the war against Ukraine… We never want to live in a divided Europe again"; every guest received a piece of the Berlin Wall.

**Context:** The meeting and Macron's call to reopen Ukraine's NATO path were covered in the 20:30 edition; Putin's "come to Moscow" offer was story 1. After the leaders left, Kushner and Witkoff met Zelensky and the national security advisers of Germany, the UK, France, Italy and Poland plus senior EU and NATO officials to prepare the next round with Russia, "possibly next week" (Axios). For the EU, the Secretary-General of the EEAS attended "on behalf of HR/VP Kallas" (@EEAS_SecGen via @eu_eeas).

**Sources:** [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/11/20/trump-pushes-putin-ukraine-war-deal), [Bundesregierung press conference](https://www.bundeskanzler.de/bk-de/aktuelles/-wir-haben-eine-klare-idee-vom-frieden--2461988), [The Guardian live](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/19/russia-ukraine-war-coalition-of-the-willing-europe-latest-news-updates), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-kerch-bridge-putin-crimea-7b4a86809dcd466bba97d374045a1a78), [@jaredkushner](https://x.com/i/status/2123538056275783718), [and](https://x.com/i/status/2123538445746524459), [@SEPeaceMissions](https://x.com/i/status/2123557907107045790), [@bundeskanzler](https://x.com/i/status/2123495382839919025), [and](https://x.com/i/status/2123478423511159169), [@ZelenskyyUa](https://x.com/i/status/2123517012739862634), [@eu_eeas](https://x.com/i/status/2123533578235510903), [@MofaJapan_en](https://x.com/i/status/2123647093181239634)
articles.why: Washington now wants Europe at the table, but the door is opened by US envoys and the call goes to a national leader ("Friedrich"), not to the Union. The working group that prepares the talks is again the E5 capitals, with the EU institutions in attendance. A guarantee "based on Article 5" offered only if it is "in America's interest" is the clearest argument yet for Europe to build its own deterrent capability instead of renting one.
articles.watch: Trump's White House press conference today (12:00 Washington time); the date and format of the next round with Russia; any Merz–Putin call; Russia's own reading of the "Article 5" claim (no Russian confirmation found so far).

articles.headline: EU loan money can now buy US weapons for Ukraine through NATO's PURL
articles.summary:
**Ukraine's Cabinet approved a General Framework Arrangement with NATO that lets Kyiv send part of the EU's Ukraine Support Loan for 2026–2027 into PURL packages of US-made weapons (Ukraine's Ministry of Defence).**

Each contribution goes into a NATO account, is tied to a specific package and to the product list Ukraine submits to the European Commission under the loan, and stays Ukraine's money until NATO finalises the document with the US Department of War and Washington confirms the package. NATO acts "solely as an authorised financial intermediary" and is not buyer, seller or guarantor. PURL, launched in July 2025, raised nearly $7 billion in its first year, and Ukraine receives about 95% of its Patriot interceptors, including PAC-3, through it (MoD Ukraine).

**Context:** The decision was announced on 18 November and reposted by @F_CEAFE after the Berlin meeting, where von der Leyen presented the new €45 billion loan (20:30 edition, story 2).

Background: CEAFE has questioned NATO's PURL scheme since it began in 2025: in December 2025 it asked whether SAFE was "just another PURL-style program to channel our money to US weapons producers", and in May 2026 it warned that paying for US weapons through PURL depletes European arsenals and turns Europe's industry into a parts supplier for US primes.

**Sources:** [MoD Ukraine](https://mod.gov.ua/en/news/purl-us-weapons-eu-loan-funds), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-economy/4186159-ukraine-to-use-eu-loan-funds-to-pay-for-us-weapons-through-purl.html), [@DefenceU](https://x.com/i/status/2123501815622750636), [@DefenceU](https://x.com/i/status/2123506696467128687), [@F_CEAFE](https://x.com/i/status/1995634348343865560), [@F_CEAFE](https://x.com/i/status/2059868875567591442)
articles.why: European taxpayers' money, raised as an EU loan, will flow to US industry through a NATO account. The MoD itself says PURL covers weapons that "cannot always be quickly replaced with European equivalents", which is exactly the gap European procurement should close: every euro spent this way builds jobs, R&D and production lines in the US, not in Europe, and keeps Ukraine's air defence dependent on US export approval. The European alternative for air defence exists (SAMP/T NG, IRIS-T SLM) but lacks the scale that joint EU orders would give it.
articles.watch: How large a share of the €45 billion is earmarked for PURL; whether the Commission's product list rules ("European preference") limit it.

articles.headline: China's defence minister in London, the first such visit in 26 years
articles.summary:
**Chinese Defence Minister Admiral Dong Jun held talks in London with UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting on 19 November; both sides agreed "to deliver on the important consensus reached by the two heads of state" and promote "steady, sound and sustainable" military ties (China's Ministry of National Defense, state source).**

Ahead of the talks Streeting wrote in The Times that Britain must "extend the hand of diplomacy" without "lowering our guard", called China the UK's third-largest trading partner with the world's largest active military, and said Xi could be "a restraining influence on the worst instincts of Putin's war machine" (Anadolu; VOA). In a written statement to Parliament he said it was the first visit by a Chinese defence minister in 26 years (VOA). Neither side published the agenda or concrete outcomes (VOA).

**Sources:** [mod.gov.cn](http://www.mod.gov.cn/gfbw/qwfb/16500971.html), [@ChinaMilBugle](https://x.com/i/status/2123613719766901142), [@ChinaMilBugle](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/britain-seeks-closer-ties-with-china-while-guarding-against-espionage-cyberattacks/4131405), [VOA Chinese](https://www.voachinese.com/a/china-defense-minister-visit-uk-streeting-said-dialogue-will-not-lower-uk-s-guard-20261119/8225739.html)
articles.why: London is opening its own military channel with Beijing one day after the Shenzhen summit, and Streeting compared it with direct contacts by the US, French, German and Italian defence ministers (VOA). Each European capital is talking to China separately; none has China's scale on its own. A common EU channel would carry more weight than a series of national ones.
articles.watch: Any UK readout; whether a standing crisis hotline is agreed.

articles.headline: EU–UK summit in Brussels today: food, carbon market and youth deals
articles.summary:
**António Costa and Ursula von der Leyen host UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham in Brussels today for the second EU–UK summit (press conference around 13:25 Brussels time) (Council of the EU).**

The two sides hope to announce three deals initiated under Keir Starmer: an agri-food (SPS) agreement under which the UK aligns with EU standards, not expected to take effect until 2028; linking of the EU and UK emissions trading systems; and a Youth Experience Scheme (The Guardian; draft joint statement published by Agence Europe). The draft statement says the two sides are "implementing the EU-UK Security and Defence Partnership" and that the Trade and Cooperation Agreement "functions effectively, notwithstanding certain barriers" (Agence Europe). The summit was planned for July but postponed when Starmer resigned (The Guardian).

**Sources:** [Council of the EU](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/meetings/international-summit/2026/11/20/), [media advisory](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/18/media-advisory-eu-united-kingdom-summit/), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/19/eu-uk-summit-explainer-burnham-brexit-brussels), [The Guardian](https://aeur.eu/f/ohe), [Reuters via Euronext](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/turkeys-trade-minister-urges-eu-include-it-made-europe-rules), [@anadoluagency](https://x.com/i/status/2123612309079851471), [@Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2123569549836509495)
articles.why: The UK is back at the EU's door on security and trade, and France and Germany want "special status" for Britain in the future "Made in Europe" rules (Reuters). Turkey is pressing for the same: its trade minister Ömer Bolat warned in Berlin that leaving Turkey outside "Made in EU" would erode three decades of integrated supply chains (Reuters via Euronext). Who counts as "European" in procurement is now the core question of European preference.
articles.watch: The final joint statement; whether UK participation in SAFE defence procurement is mentioned.

articles.headline: Iran at the IAEA Board: West presses for inspections, Russia, China and Iran set conditions
articles.summary:
**At the IAEA Board of Governors in Vienna, the US and the E3 (France, Germany, UK) pressed Iran to let inspectors back into its bombed enrichment sites and account for its highly enriched uranium, with a draft resolution on Iran's safeguards (Al-Monitor; US Mission Vienna joint statement; EU statement).**

Russia, speaking also on behalf of China and Iran, said inspections can resume only after hostilities end and with guarantees against new attacks (@mission_rf; Anadolu). Iran's mission: "You cannot bomb nuclear facilities, continue threatening…" (@PMIRAN_Vienna). Iran's MFA spokesman rejected new US claims that Iran is developing biological or chemical weapons ("The allegations keep changing"), after Israel's foreign minister Gideon Sa'ar spoke of Iranian efforts "involving unconventional weapons" (@IRIMFA_SPOX; Sa'ar via @ClashReport). Foreign Minister Araghchi answered a remark by Israel's ambassador in Washington with: "We did not know that the Israeli Ambassador to Washington was the Commander-in-Chief of the U.S. Military." Trump said Xi and Putin want the war on Iran to end and are conveying that message to Tehran (Al Jazeera).

**Sources:** [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/west-presses-iran-iaea-let-inspections-resume-bombed-nuclear-sites), [US Mission Vienna](https://vienna.usmission.gov/joint-statement-agenda-item-3f-iaea-board-of-governors-meeting-november-2026/), [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/eurasia/moscow-beijing-tehran-say-un-nuclear-watchdog-can-resume-inspections-in-iran-after-hostilities-end/4129946), [@Amb_Ulyanov](https://x.com/i/status/2123503994597224580), [and](https://x.com/i/status/2123537218304135254), [@PMIRAN_Vienna via @Amb_Ulyanov](https://x.com/i/status/2123613667677851889), [@IRIMFA_EN](https://x.com/i/status/2123500205517467688), [@araghchi](https://x.com/i/status/2123636912392994951), [@ClashReport](https://x.com/i/status/2123500453715648819), [@AJEnglish](https://x.com/i/status/2123511097772982312)
articles.why: The E3 act as a national trio alongside Washington, while the EU speaks in a separate statement. Russia's ambassador Ulyanov complained that X "restricts artificially" the distribution of his IAEA statement. Inspections are frozen until a war that Europe does not control ends.
articles.watch: The Board vote on the US–E3 draft; Iran's reaction.

articles.headline: Hours after Shenzhen, the US bars Chinese telecoms from US phone numbers
articles.summary:
**The US Federal Communications Commission voted on 19 November to bar China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom and other IP-enabled providers from direct access to US phone numbers on national-security grounds, "just hours after" Trump's talks with Xi in Shenzhen (SCMP).**

The FCC said new "national security-focused certifications" will be required before VoIP providers get number access. China's reaction to this vote: none found yet; when the FCC moved against Chinese carriers and testing labs in late October, MFA spokesman Guo Jiakun called it an "abuse of state power" and said China would take "necessary measures" (China Daily, 30 Oct).

**Sources:** [scmp.com](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3375128/fcc-votes-ban-chinese-telecoms-direct-access-us-phone-numbers), [China Daily](https://global.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202610/30/WS6ae47e5ce4b06d4aa0566286.html)
articles.why: Washington excludes Chinese operators from its own networks on security grounds while asking Europeans to keep their markets open to US firms; the EU has no equivalent instrument it applies with similar speed.
articles.watch: MFA/MOFCOM response; whether Beijing retaliates against US firms.

articles.headline: Update: After Shenzhen, Putin tells the Europeans to "come to Moscow"; Merz calls the summit a "Yalta format"
articles.summary:
**At his press conference in Shenzhen after the first US–China–Russia leaders' meeting, Vladimir Putin said Russia had proposed, "through diplomatic channels", that European representatives come to Moscow to set out their positions, after which Moscow "will decide in what format to continue the dialogue with Ukraine" (Reuters via Internazionale; AFP via Arab News; Politico).**

He said Washington had asked "quite insistently" for European participation and that "discussing security issues, including security in Europe, without Europeans is pointless", but called any military cooperation between Kyiv and the EU "a problem" and the deployment of any troops to Ukraine "unacceptable" (DW; Anadolu). He added that "without a change of political elites in some European countries, probably nothing can be done to fully normalise relations" (Anadolu, Turkish state agency). @F_CEAFE quoted his line that the EU representatives were invited "to discuss… ensuring security for Ukraine, Russia, and Europe as a whole."

**Context:** The Declaration toward Peace adopted in Shenzhen (14:30 edition, story 1) was negotiated by three leaders with no European present. In Berlin a few hours later, Friedrich Merz called the trilateral a "photo op" and said such a "Yalta format cannot bring peace" to Ukraine; he named Germany, France, the UK, Poland and Italy as the countries that would speak for Europe (DW live). Michel Barnier, reposted by @F_CEAFE: "En Chine aujourd'hui il manque un drapeau, un continent: l'Union européenne." Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen: "I think Putin will be even more emboldened after today's meeting… he will hit us Europeans even harder" (DW, citing Reuters). NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, asked if he was worried about the summit: "No, no, no… it is important that leaders meet… also from nuclear powers" (NATO transcript).

**Sources:** [@F_CEAFE](https://x.com/i/status/2123461732756529484), [@F_CEAFE](https://x.com/i/status/2123458784685096991), [Internazionale/Reuters](https://www.internazionale.it/ultime-notizie-reuters/2026/11/19/putin-says-russia-invited-europeans-to-moscow-to-clarify-position-on-ukraine-talks), [Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/19/come-to-moscow-putin-tells-europeans-after-shenzhen-summit), [Arab News/AFP](https://www.arabnews.com/world/putin-invites-europeans-to-moscow-to-discuss-them-joining-ukraine-talks-3012957), [Anadolu](https://aa.com.tr/en/eurasia/putin-says-russia-invited-european-representatives-to-moscow-for-security-talks/4131114), [DW live](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraines-allies-attend-coalition-of-the-willing-summit-in-berlin/live-79986520), [NATO](https://www.nato.int/en/news-and-events/events/transcripts/2026/11/19/doorstep-statement-by-the-nato-secretary-general-at-the-meeting-of-the-coalition-of-the-willing)
articles.why: Moscow is now offering to decide whether, and how, Europe sits at the table, and is addressing "the Europeans" rather than the Union and its High Representative. Europe's own answer in Berlin was again a group of five capitals (the E5), not the EU institutions that the Dublin formula of 13 November also named. The invitation tests whether the Union can answer with one voice or will be split into national channels to Moscow, which is the scenario CEAFE warns against: no member state alone has the weight to sit at a table with the US, China and Russia.
articles.watch: Whether the EU, the E5 or individual capitals reply to Moscow, and who would go; the EU leaders' special summit on 26–27 November; Trump's press conference at the White House on 20 November at 12:00 (Washington time).

articles.headline: Update: Berlin Coalition of the Willing: Macron reopens Ukraine's NATO path, Kushner reports progress on guarantees
articles.summary:
**The Coalition of the Willing meeting hosted by Merz ended with Europe's leaders pressing for a seat in the talks.**

Emmanuel Macron said: "Faced with the maximalist nature of the Russian position, I believe we need to reopen the question of Ukraine's accession to NATO," and called for anti-missile systems and interceptors to be deployed now (DW). US envoy Jared Kushner said Trump joined by phone with an update on Shenzhen, that the talks "made a lot of progress on what those security guarantees can look like" and a post-war prosperity plan, and that Russia was "comfortable" with NATO-like guarantees (DW, citing Reuters). Zelensky: "America fully understands why strong and coordinated European participation at the negotiations is necessary." Ursula von der Leyen said "our new €45 billion loan" supports Ukraine and that the 22nd sanctions package is on the way; the Commission says Ukraine's 2026 needs are covered and the €45 billion would cover two thirds of its 2027 needs (@vonderleyen; @ComisionEuropea). António Costa restated Europe's "principles and priorities for the peace negotiations" (@eucopresident).

**Context:** The meeting opened in the 14:30 edition. On the same day, Russian strikes on Kyiv damaged the embassies of the Netherlands and Austria and drone debris fell on the grounds of Ukraine's Foreign Ministry (@MFA_Ukraine; Germany's Foreign Office expressed solidarity with the Netherlands, Austria, Brazil and South Africa).

**Sources:** [@vonderleyen](https://x.com/i/status/2123465115936977138), [@ComisionEuropea](https://x.com/i/status/2123471865968533780), [@eucopresident](https://x.com/i/status/2123464271371571438), [@ZelenskyyUa](https://x.com/i/status/2123440619372626385), [@bundeskanzler](https://x.com/i/status/2123441872408309872), [@MAECgob](https://x.com/i/status/2123458136182866049), [@MFA_Ukraine](https://x.com/i/status/2123456407697514714), [@GermanyDiplo](https://x.com/i/status/2123464159417545002)
articles.why: Europe is again paying for the war (the €45 billion loan) and planning the guarantees, while the terms are discussed by Washington and Moscow. Spain's foreign ministry summed up the position: "Nada sobre Ucrania se puede decidir sin Ucrania. Nada sobre la seguridad europea se puede decidir sin Europa" (@MAECgob). Macron's call on NATO accession goes the other way from Putin's red line in story 1, so the two statements made on the same day frame the next round.
articles.watch: A written outcome from Berlin; the 22nd sanctions package; Russia's reply to the guarantees Kushner described.

articles.headline: Denmark ratifies the Greenland defence deal with the US, 109–0
articles.summary:
**The Danish Parliament unanimously approved (109–0) the agreement between Greenland, Denmark and the United States that amends the 1951 defence agreement on Greenland; Greenland's parliament approved it on 3 November, so Copenhagen can now notify Washington and the agreement becomes legally binding (Danish Parliament; AP).**

The deal, signed on 22 September in New York, gives the US underwater access around Greenland and specific permission to build a missile defence system, recognises Greenland as an equal partner and paves the way for more US bases (The Guardian; AP). President Trump could conclude it without Congress (Danish Parliament). Marco Rubio: the ratification "will make us all safer, stronger, and more secure" (@SecRubio). Denmark's foreign minister said the deal "removes all uncertainty" but that trust in the US needs rebuilding (The Guardian).

Background: CEAFE has followed US designs on Greenland since November 2019, when it warned that US interest could mean backing the island's independence from Denmark, and so from the EU. In November 2025 it noted that Denmark's push to defend Greenland was "not #EUDefense", and in January 2026 it criticised Copenhagen for continuing to buy US weapons.

**Sources:** [Danish Parliament](https://www.thedanishparliament.dk/en/news/2026/11/the-danish-parliament-approves-agreement-on-defence-of-greenland), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/denmark-greenland-us-security-arctic-north-atlantic-a392abbba5c2f1bccbbb372e3d38769d), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/19/danish-mps-approve-greenland-security-pact-us), [@SecRubio](https://x.com/i/status/2123424049690730866), [@F_CEAFE](https://x.com/i/status/1191019343112486914), [@F_CEAFE](https://x.com/i/status/2009941819728216286)
articles.why: The pact closes a crisis in which a US president threatened to take territory from an EU member state. It was negotiated bilaterally by Denmark and Greenland, not by the Union, and it extends US military infrastructure, including missile defence, on an Arctic territory linked to the EU. It shows how far the US security umbrella in Europe is still negotiated state by state.
articles.watch: Formal notification to Washington; the location and scope of new US bases and the missile-defence system.

articles.headline: ICJ rules that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
articles.summary:
**The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in northern Rakhine State during the 2017 "clearance operations", the first time the Court has held a State responsible for genocide (ICJ press release No.**

2026/30; UN News). It found Myanmar failed to prevent and punish genocide, but did not directly and publicly incite it. It ordered Myanmar to investigate and prosecute those responsible, allow the safe and voluntary return of displaced Rohingya, and compensate them; Myanmar must report within two years, and the amount of compensation will be set later (ICJ). The case (The Gambia v. Myanmar) had 11 intervening States. About 10,000 Rohingya were killed and more than 700,000 fled to Bangladesh (BBC).

**Sources:** [ICJ press release](https://www.refworld.org/sites/default/files/2026-11/178-20261119-pre-01-00-en.pdf), [UN News](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/11/1168836), [AP](https://apnews.com/article/rohingya-myanmar-genocide-court-icj-30df77b12bf3f911f1100e77ebe3973a), [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cr93z32d2344t), [@NorwayMFA](https://x.com/i/status/2123404119381856584), [@FCDOGovUK](https://x.com/i/status/2123401197180641735)
articles.why: Several European states intervened in the case, and the UK and Norway welcomed the ruling (@FCDOGovUK; @NorwayMFA). Critics on X contrasted their position on Myanmar with their stance on Israel (reposted by @F_CEAFE). The judgment is binding but the Court can only refer non-compliance to the UN Security Council (AP).
articles.watch: Myanmar's response; Security Council follow-up; the Bangladesh refugee camps.

articles.headline: Reuters: Trump official floated Guyana ceding part of the Essequibo to Venezuela
articles.summary:
**Jeremy Lewin, then State Department policy planning chief, told Guyana's foreign secretary Robert Persaud in September that he could help broker territorial talks with acting Venezuelan President Delcy Rodríguez, and, according to two sources, floated Venezuela taking partial control of the Essequibo region, two thirds of Guyana's territory (Reuters via Investing.com).**

Lewin said the talks were "preliminary" and directed by the White House after Rodríguez wrote to Trump in May. The State Department said its position on the boundary "had not changed"; Guyana's Foreign Ministry said it had received that assurance and that the focus remains the pending ICJ ruling (Guyana DPI).

**Sources:** [Reuters via Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/exclusivetrump-official-floated-ceding-guyanese-territory-to-venezuela-sources-say-5038474), [Guyana DPI](https://dpi.gov.gy/press-statement-united-states-position-on-guyana-venezuela-border-controversy-remains-unchanged-mfaic/), [Guyana DPI](https://x.com/i/status/2123460821434896818)
articles.why: The case comes days after the US and Venezuela restored military ties (07:30 edition, story 4) and shows how quickly a small state's territorial integrity can become negotiable in great-power deals, the risk CEAFE sees for European states acting alone.

articles.headline: Update: Shenzhen "Declaration toward Peace": Trump, Xi and Putin agree on the UN, the ICC, oil products and nuclear risk, with Europe absent from the table
articles.summary:
**The first-ever meeting of the leaders of the United States, China and Russia ended in Shenzhen on Thursday with a joint "Heads of State Declaration toward Peace" (full text published by the Russian Foreign Ministry, Russian state source).**

Its four points: (1) as permanent members of the UN Security Council, the three "committed to reform the U.N." so it can respond more effectively to global challenges; (2) they "plan to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products" and "reaffirmed the importance of stable energy flows"; (3) they recognised "the principle of state consent and respect for immunities of State officials" as "of paramount importance" and agreed that "the International Criminal Court and other similar bodies must not abuse their jurisdiction"; (4) they reaffirmed that "a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought" and will hold a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing proliferation. Before the declaration, Trump told Xi and Putin that he would suggest ways to protect their countries from the ICC (clip via @Acyn). Putin said the three are "united by our status as victorious powers in the Second World War" and that, at Trump's initiative, much of the US–Russia bilateral was devoted to Ukraine. Xi called the meeting "positive, constructive and fruitful" and said "positive interaction between major countries is not optional, but a must" (Chinese MFA spokesperson; Global Times, Chinese state media). Trump left China shortly afterwards (Anadolu, Turkish state agency).

**Context:** This closes the story that opened the 07:30 edition (Putin–Trump bilateral). As we noted then, Europe is not at the table, and it still cannot agree on who speaks for it: the Dublin formula of 13 November gave the talks to "the EU institutions and the E5" rather than to the High Representative, Kaja Kallas, whose own words on Russia ("if you would have more like small nations it's not a bad thing if the big power is actually much smaller", Lennart Meri Conference, 18 May 2024) have weighed against her as a negotiator (07:30 edition, story 2).

**European reactions in this window:** Former Commissioner Michel Barnier: "En Chine aujourd'hui il manque un drapeau, un continent: l'Union européenne" ("In China today one flag, one continent is missing: the European Union"). Former Commissioner Thierry Breton: "Seuls, face aux empires" ("Alone, facing the empires"). Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski, in Budapest: "We will not accept any new spheres of influence in Europe", and on Shenzhen: "What is this supposed to be, another Yalta?" (clip via Clash Report). Germany's Minister of State for Europe, Gunther Krichbaum, at the General Affairs Council: "Nothing about Ukraine without Ukraine, nothing about Europe without Europe."

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2123372469461328015), [t.me](https://t.me/MFARussia/33494), [t.me](https://t.me/MFARussia/33490), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2123351927945634175), [China Military Bugle](https://x.com/i/status/2123382291363971240), [Chinese MFA spokesperson](https://x.com/i/status/2123354920699191354), [Global Times](https://x.com/i/status/2123377920182026430), [@RapidResponse47](https://x.com/i/status/2123359138617172080), [@RapidResponse47](https://x.com/i/status/2123357612280328697), [@Acyn](https://x.com/i/status/2123358513850155283), [Anadolu](https://x.com/i/status/2123371188147622122), [Anadolu](https://x.com/i/status/2123308738043949119), [Anadolu](https://x.com/i/status/2123376434542416321), [Michel Barnier](https://x.com/i/status/2123321849245565393), [Thierry Breton](https://x.com/i/status/2123310308294812085), [Polish MFA](https://x.com/i/status/2123351790766965043), [Clash Report](https://x.com/i/status/2123329229643268420), [Germany in the EU](https://x.com/i/status/2123383156879294510), [Diplomacy page](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy), [Euronews](https://x.com/i/status/2123369338979971373)
articles.why: Three powers have just signed, without any European present, a text on UN reform, international justice and nuclear risk — subjects that the EU and its member states treat as their own. Point 3 directly undercuts the ICC, which the EU supports as a matter of policy and which has had an arrest warrant out against Putin since March 2023; point 2 commits Washington, Moscow and Beijing to more oil-product supply at a time when the EU is still trying to cut Russian energy revenue. No EU member state alone has the weight to be invited to such a table; that is CEAFE's case for a single European voice instead of E3/E5 formats and competing envoys.
articles.watch: Whether the "dialogue on reducing nuclear risks" gets a date and format; EU and ICC reactions to point 3; what Witkoff and Kushner tell the Coalition of the Willing in Berlin this afternoon.

articles.headline: Berlin: Coalition of the Willing meets with Witkoff and Kushner as Shenzhen ends
articles.summary:
**Chancellor Friedrich Merz is hosting the Coalition of the Willing at the Federal Chancellery under the motto "United for Peace in Ukraine and European Security", co-chaired with France and the United Kingdom (E3), with heads of state or government from 37 countries plus António Costa, Ursula von der Leyen, Kaja Kallas and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte (Bundesregierung).**

President Zelensky arrived with his team: "More than 40 partners will be represented, including the team of the American President. Ukraine's priorities are strengthening our air defense, energy and financial support, the diplomatic track…" US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff said they were heading to Berlin "to consult with President Zelenskyy and European leaders"; they are expected to brief on Trump's talks in China (Interfax-Ukraine, Kyiv Post). The agenda covers security guarantees in three parts: support for Ukraine's armed forces, a Multinational Force for Ukraine, and legal and political guarantees (Interfax-Ukraine).

**Sources:** [@ZelenskyyUa](https://x.com/i/status/2123377054158643397), [@jaredkushner](https://x.com/i/status/2123319813883748586), [Bundesregierung](https://www.bundeskanzler.de/bk-de/aktuelles/koalition-der-willigen-in-berlin-2461162), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90536), [Interfax-Ukraine](https://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/1239165.html), [DW live](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraines-allies-gather-in-berlin-for-coalition-of-the-willing-summit/live-79986520)
articles.why: On the same day, Europe's leaders meet in Berlin and learn second-hand, from US envoys, what was agreed in Shenzhen. The E3 co-chairs the format while the EU's institutions attend as guests: another sign of the fragmented European representation that story 1 describes.
articles.watch: Final statement and any figures on the multinational force; the US envoys' read-out of Shenzhen.

articles.headline: EU institutions: Commission hit by a large AI-assisted cyberattack; Swedish diplomat Lars Danielsson named sanctions envoy
articles.summary:
**The European Commission was hit by a cyberattack on its internal HR and medical-reimbursement systems (Sysper, MyPMO, JSIS), first reported by Politico Europe on Thursday.**

Commission spokesperson Thomas Regnier said the attack used "a publicly available AI tool", was first detected on 22 October, involved no ransom demand and that there is no "evidence of a data breach affecting Commission staff as a whole"; he did not attribute it (Euronews). Politico reported that CERT-EU identified the tool as ARTEX, that the top crisis-management body met and that Tech Commissioner Henna Virkkunen briefed the College on Wednesday. Separately, the Commission has created an EU Sanctions Office under Commissioner Maria Luís Albuquerque (operational 16 January 2027) and appointed Lars Danielsson, Sweden's former permanent representative to the EU (2016–2023), as International Special Envoy for the Implementation of EU Sanctions from 6 February 2027, succeeding David O'Sullivan (Commission decision of 18 Nov reported by Brussels Times, Kyiv Post; congratulated by Sweden's prime minister).

**Sources:** [Politico Europe](https://www.politico.eu/newsletter/brussels-playbook/cyberattack-hits-the-commission/), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/19/eu-commission-hit-by-large-scale-cyberattack-with-data-leakage-unknown), [Reuters via GMA](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010091/european-commission-targeted-in-cyberattack-politico-reports/story/), [@SouveraineTech](https://x.com/i/status/2123348325961240987), [Swedish PM via @SweMFA](https://x.com/i/status/2123295237754048568), [Brussels Times](https://www.brusselstimes.com/2412656/eu-revamps-sanctions-strategy-with-new-office-and-envoy-for-enforcement), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90535)
articles.why: The Commission has been breached three times this year (January mobile-device infrastructure, March Europa.eu cloud, now HR systems, per Euronews). HR data (names, grades, home addresses) can feed targeted campaigns against EU staff: digital sovereignty and the EU's own cyber-defence are security matters, not IT matters. The sanctions envoy update continues the 20:30 story on the new Sanctions Office.
articles.watch: Attribution of the attack; whether personal data was taken; the 22nd sanctions package against Russia (Kyiv Post).

articles.headline: Indo-Pacific: Japan–India "2+2" in Tokyo, Russian bombers near Taiwan, Germany–Japan military talks
articles.summary:
**Japan and India held their 4th Foreign and Defence Ministers' Meeting ("2+2") in Tokyo (Motegi, Koizumi, Jaishankar, Rajnath Singh) and issued a joint statement on a Free and Open Indo-Pacific and defence cooperation including maritime security, followed by the 19th Japan–India Foreign Ministers' Strategic Dialogue.**

Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported two sorties of Russian Tu-95 bombers entering its ADIZ from the south and exiting north-east of Keelung on Thursday morning, during the Shenzhen summit. Japan and Germany held their 18th military-to-military dialogue in Tokyo. Japan also reported that the Canadian frigate HMCS Regina completed Canada's 16th mission monitoring illicit ship-to-ship transfers with North Korean vessels.

**Sources:** [@MofaJapan_en](https://x.com/i/status/2123362045945090055), [@MofaJapan_en](https://x.com/i/status/2123384371898130480), [@MofaJapan_en](https://x.com/i/status/2123369979856953726), [@SpokespersonMoD](https://x.com/i/status/2123356253460238657), [@ModJapan_en](https://x.com/i/status/2123309207638413732), [@MoNDefense](https://x.com/i/status/2123305270394994777)
articles.why: Asia's middle powers deepen defence ties among themselves while the great powers meet; Germany's dialogue with Japan is a national track where a common EU security policy towards the Indo-Pacific is still thin.

articles.headline: WTO: record stockpile of trade restrictions in 2026
articles.summary:
**The WTO Director-General's annual trade-monitoring overview says the pace of new tariffs and other non-facilitating measures "rose sharply in the first half of 2026" and the stockpile reached a record level.**

Members introduced 333 new restrictive measures in H1 2026 alone, more than the 300 in all of 2025, but also 466 trade-facilitating measures (391 in 2025); export-facilitating measures covered a record USD 570 billion (2.3%) of world exports, much of it temporary action linked to disruption in the Strait of Hormuz.

**Sources:** [WTO](https://www.wto.org/english/news_e/news26_e/tmwto_17nov26_552_e.htm), [@wto](https://x.com/i/status/2123380117111980526)
articles.why: The EU, the world's largest trading bloc, depends on open rules; a rise in restrictions and the use of trade as a weapon reward scale and collective bargaining power, which only the Union as a whole has.
